chars.HUSBAND: a Moroccan man around 30, short black hair, trimmed beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark blue jeans
chars.WIFE: a Moroccan woman around 28, wearing a teal hijab, a beige office blazer over a white blouse and black trousers

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a modern Moroccan apartment kitchen at midday, WIFE in her office clothes stirs a tagine pot on the stove in a hurry, glancing at her wristwatch, handbag on the counter, ready to leave for work. Warm light, 2D cartoon style, no text.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: HUSBAND at his desk in a busy Moroccan office, tired, looking up at a wall clock showing four o'clock, papers piled around him. 2D cartoon style, no text.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: HUSBAND back home lifts the lid of an empty cooking pot on the kitchen stove and stares inside, disappointed and surprised, hungry. Moroccan apartment kitchen, 2D cartoon style, no text.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: HUSBAND sits alone at a small dining table with an empty plate, chin on his hand, sighing patiently, thinking. Moroccan living room with low sofas in the background, 2D cartoon style, no text.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the apartment doorway: HUSBAND stands at the door with his work bag, shocked and annoyed, while WIFE sleeps deeply on the Moroccan salon sofa at noon under a blanket. Kitchen visible behind with nothing cooking. 2D cartoon style, no text.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In the Moroccan salon HUSBAND gestures angrily, complaining, while WIFE sits on the sofa starting to cry, wiping tears. 2D cartoon style, no text.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: WIFE crying and pointing at HUSBAND, shouting that he does not care about her, HUSBAND steps back surprised with raised hands. Moroccan living room, 2D cartoon style, no text.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: HUSBAND hugs WIFE gently in the Moroccan salon to calm her, his face over her shoulder looks guilty and confused. 2D cartoon style, no text.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: HUSBAND alone in the kitchen holding his open, nearly empty wallet, raising one eyebrow at it suspiciously, thinking about money. Moroccan apartment, 2D cartoon style, no text.
